quality_gates.policy: Freeze these thresholds before collecting M6 quality evidence. A changed threshold requires a new contract version and must be recorded before the next sample is reviewed.

overall_decision.pass: Every applicable dimension passes and every required sample is complete.
overall_decision.hold: Any dimension fails, required evidence is missing, or a reviewer disagreement remains unadjudicated.
overall_decision.not_applicable: Use only when the current product and the proposed change expose no cases for that dimension. A missing sample is HOLD, not N/A.
overall_decision.combine: Do not average dimensions or let a strong result in one dimension offset a failure in another.

review_protocol.disagreement: A designated editorial decision owner adjudicates disagreements before the case is counted.
review_protocol.retained_evidence: Keep case IDs, structured outcomes, and source digests. Do not commit writer sentences, raw query context, or external source text.

stable_hash.encoding: UTF-8 bytes of the exact strings
stable_hash.order: digest ascending; ties compare stable_unit_id UTF-8 bytes ascending
stable_hash.normalization: none; do not trim, NFC-normalize, or locale-sort sample identifiers

relation_tuple.stable_unit_id: JSON.stringify([source_record_id, source_sense_id, target_record_id, target_sense_id ?? null, type])

relation_gap_record.eligibility: valid searchable canonical record with no outgoing relation on any sense

ambiguous_query.stable_unit_id: exact runtime-normalized query string, preserving its codepoints
ambiguous_query.eligibility: runtime exact-query result expands to at least two ordered (record, sense) candidate options in interactive DictionaryPanel exact mode

writer_task.stable_unit_id: opaque_task_id assigned before outcome collection; never derived from writer text
writer_task.eligibility: preassigned writer task in one of the fixed intent slots

relation_direct.sample_size: min(60, current direct-tuple count); census when the current count is 60 or less.

relation_other_types.unit: directed relation tuple, sampled separately for each non-direct relation type
relation_other_types.per_type_sample_size: min(20, current tuple count for that type); census when a type has fewer than 20 tuples.
relation_other_types.minimum_types_reported: Report all eight canonical relation types separately; a type with zero tuples is coverage evidence, not a pass on correctness.

relation_gaps.unit: searchable record with no outgoing relation on any sense
relation_gaps.sample_size: min(80, current relation-empty searchable record count)
relation_gaps.strata: record_type × first-sense POS; first sense follows canonical order.
relation_gaps.allocation: Set each initial quota to min(10, stratum population). Allocate remaining slots to remaining capacities with the Hamilton largest-remainder method: floor each exact proportional quota, then give leftover slots by descending fractional remainder, breaking ties by stratum UTF-8 byte order. If a stratum reaches capacity, repeat over the remaining capacities.

writer_tasks.source: Writer-authored needs and Typewriter-authored prompts; do not retain the writers’ original sentences in Git.
writer_tasks.participant_allocation: Assign five participants to pattern A and five to pattern B before collection. Pattern A per participant: 3 direct replacement, 2 sense choice, 2 expression exploration, 2 relation exploration, 1 no-data/policy boundary. Pattern B: 3 direct replacement, 2 sense choice, 1 expression exploration, 3 relation exploration, 1 no-data/policy boundary.
writer_tasks.selection: Fill the assigned slots before reviewing outcomes. If a slot is unfilled, HOLD; do not replace a result after seeing its outcome.

ranking.unit: exact query whose ordered writer-facing candidate list has at least two record/sense options
ranking.candidate_expansion: One candidate per record when it has zero or one sense; one candidate per sense when a record has multiple senses. Preserve runtime record order and canonical sense order, matching DictionaryPanel exact-mode candidateOptions.

dimensions.baseline: M5-15 global semantic audit covers every current record and sense with zero open blocking findings.
dimensions.pass: All canonical/schema/integrity/semantic-audit checks pass; every changed record and sense is covered; zero blocking findings.

dimensions.baseline: Current direct relations are counted, but the full 5K direct-relation set has no new independent review result.
dimensions.pass: At least 95% of sampled direct tuples are judged substitutable in the recorded sense and direction; zero critical POS or sense-boundary errors.
dimensions.sample: Stable-hash sample up to 60 directed tuples; current population of 22 is a census.

dimensions.baseline: Current relation density and type counts are measured; correctness and usefulness are not inferred from counts.
dimensions.pass: For every non-empty relation type, at least 80% of its sample is both writer-useful and correctly typed, sense-bound, and directed; zero critical POS or sense-boundary errors.
dimensions.sample: Up to 20 stable-hash directed tuples per non-direct type; report each type separately. Keep direct relations under their stricter gate.

dimensions.baseline: Relation-bearing and relation-empty searchable records are measured separately; no target density is authorized.
dimensions.pass: Review every selected gap and disposition it. At least 80% of writer tasks whose stated need is relation exploration reach one relevant result; record remaining high-demand gaps explicitly.
dimensions.sample: Up to 80 relation-empty searchable records, stratified by record type and first-sense POS, plus the relation-exploration writer tasks.

dimensions.baseline: The role-independent exact runtime and M4 cases are exercised; the baseline also exhaustively checks every current canonical exact key.
dimensions.pass: 100% of valid searchable canonical lemmas and curated search forms resolve to their expected IDs; zero unexpected results or missing results; all non-pending M4 cases retain their expected results and policy boundaries.
dimensions.sample: Exhaustive unique canonical keys plus the shared M4 regression corpus. Pending cases remain pending until an explicit policy decision.

dimensions.baseline: The current exact-search UI exposes ordered record/sense candidate choices, including sense choices within one polysemous record; writer preference for that order has not been measured.
dimensions.pass: For a ranking or sense-order change, at least 80% of the top writer-facing candidates match the adjudicated writer choice across at least 20 ambiguous exact-query tasks; preserve deterministic record and sense ordering.
dimensions.sample: Stable-hash sample up to 40 exact queries with at least two writer-facing (record, sense) candidates. N/A only when no such case is exposed; a ranking change with fewer than 20 cases is HOLD.

dimensions.baseline: No current 5K writer-task success rate was measured.
dimensions.pass: At least 80 of 100 tasks produce a result the writer says they would use or deliberately adapt; every intent and any POS/record-type slice with at least 10 tasks scores at least 70%; zero critical misleading-result cases.
dimensions.sample: 100 tasks from 10 writers, ten tasks each, with the fixed intent counts above.

inherited_m5_risks.disposition: Keep each M5 proposal denominator with its stage. The stage-specific candidate noise rates do not measure the correctness of all 487 current canonical tuples.
This is a partial lower bound, not total M5 editor time; do not treat agent-gated stages as zero human time.
This correction preserves the existing bounded M6-2/M6-3 morphology contract while authorizing no corpus expansion, broader morphology, bulk relation generation, or ranking architecture.
